portfolioSummary.title: Portfolio Summary
portfolioSummary.incompletePrices: No current price for {symbols}, so the holdings they represent are not included in any total below.
portfolioSummary.incompleteFx: No exchange rate for {pairs}, so the holdings in those currencies are not included in any total below.
portfolioSummary.holdingsValueTooltip: The current market value of all securities you hold, based on the latest available prices.
portfolioSummary.cashBalanceTooltip: Uninvested cash sitting in your investment accounts, available for purchasing securities.
portfolioSummary.totalGainTooltip: The total profit or loss across all your investments: Portfolio Value minus Net Invested. Includes realized gains, unrealized gains, dividends, and interest.
portfolioSummary.netInvestedTooltip: The net amount of your own money deposited into your investment accounts. This is total contributions minus withdrawals, excluding any investment gains, dividends, or interest earned.
portfolioSummary.costBasisTooltip: What your current holdings cost to acquire, rebuilt from your transaction history: purchase prices plus the commission charged on each purchase, each converted at the rate of the trade that paid for it. Shown in your display currency. Used to calculate gains and losses.
portfolioSummary.gainLossTooltip: Unrealized gain or loss on your current holdings: market value at today's prices minus the cost basis above. Does not include realized gains from past sales, or dividends and interest received.
portfolioSummary.simpleReturnTooltip: Gain or loss against what you paid: (Market Value − Cost Basis) ÷ Cost Basis. It ignores when money arrived, so it jumps on every purchase: a 1,000 position up 20% shows +20%; buy another 1,000 and it shows +10% (200 ÷ 2,000) although nothing was lost. TWR and MWR do not have this jump.
portfolioSummary.twrTooltip: Time-weighted return of your investments since the first transaction, computed the same way as Portfolio performance: deposits, withdrawals and uninvested cash are left out, dividends and interest are counted in.
portfolioSummary.mwrTooltip: Money-weighted return (XIRR) of your investments since the first transaction: the annual rate your own money earned, weighting each purchase, sale and dividend by when it happened. Deposits, withdrawals and uninvested cash are left out. Differs from TWR when you invested more before a rise or a fall.
portfolioSummary.cagrTooltip: Compound Annual Growth Rate. Your annualized return based on Net Invested vs. current portfolio value, as if growth had been perfectly steady each year.
portfolioSummary.returnDiagnosticsLead: TWR and MWR are withheld because the history has gaps:
portfolioSummary.returnDiagnosticsRepair: Add the missing prices on each security's price history; the returns are measured over the accounts shown.
portfolioSummary.returnDiagnosticsRepairFiltered: Add the missing prices on each security's price history, or leave those accounts out of the view with the account filter above; the returns are measured over the accounts shown.
portfolioSummary.unpricedHoldings: Partial valuation: {count, plural, one {# holding has} other {# holdings have}} no current price ({symbols}), so the values below exclude {count, plural, one {it} other {them}}.

unlinkedTransfers.title: Transfers recorded as two separate rows
unlinkedTransfers.subtitle: Each of these looks like one transfer entered twice, once in each account. Until the two rows are linked, the receiving account cannot take the cost the sending one gave up, so its cost basis and gain read as unknown.
unlinkedTransfers.linkFailed: These two rows could not be linked. Reload the page and try again.

portfolioPerformance.title: Portfolio performance
portfolioPerformance.subtitle: How your investments did, without the effect of deposits, withdrawals and uninvested cash.
portfolioPerformance.empty: Not enough history to measure a return yet.
portfolioPerformance.loadFailed: The period results could not be loaded. The figures are withheld, not zero; reload the page to ask again.

reasons.incompletePrices: A withheld period starts on a day a holding had no price. Refresh prices, or add one on the security's price history.
reasons.incompleteCash: A withheld period starts on a day a cash account in this view reported no balance, so what it held is unknown rather than zero.
reasons.missingRatePairs: A withheld period needs an exchange rate the stored history does not have. Add rate history for the currency on the Currencies page.

assetAllocation.title: Asset Allocation
assetAllocation.knownValueOnly: Percentages cover known value only; some holdings could not be valued.
assetAllocation.noTagData: No tagged holdings to show. Add tags to your securities to see exposure by tag.
assetAllocation.noKeyData: No holdings carry a value for this tag key. Tag securities as key:value (e.g. country:usa) to see this breakdown.

groupedHoldings.title: Holdings by Account
groupedHoldings.accountIncomplete: Partial: this account's totals leave out holdings that could not be valued in {currency}.
groupedHoldings.cashClickTitle: Click to view cash account transactions

investmentValueChart.title: Portfolio Value Over Time
investmentValueChart.viewReportTitle: Open the full Portfolio Value report
investmentValueChart.intradayFallbackWarning: Detailed intraday pricing is not available because {holdings} use MSN Money, which does not expose intraday quotes. Showing daily snapshots instead.
investmentValueChart.intradayUnavailableTitle: Intraday view unavailable for this account mix
investmentValueChart.intradayUnavailableDescription: One or more holdings use a quote provider (MSN Money) that does not expose intraday data. Switch to a longer range to see daily snapshots.
investmentValueChart.noDataForPeriod: No investment data for this period.
investmentValueChart.incompleteTooltip: Some points in this window are missing a price or an exchange rate, so the high and the low are not shown.
investmentValueChart.valueChangeTooltip: What the securities are worth at the end of the period, less what they were worth at the start: the last point on the chart less the first. Uninvested cash is left out.
investmentValueChart.investmentResultTooltip: What your investments earned over this window. Deposits, withdrawals and uninvested cash are left out, and the percentage beside it is a time-weighted return, so buying and selling do not move it.
investmentValueChart.measuredFromClose: Since the close of trading on {date}

transactionList.title: Recent Transactions
transactionList.deleteConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this {action} transaction{security}?
transactionList.deleteConfirmGeneric: Are you sure you want to delete this transaction?

transactionForm.noSecuritiesHeld: No securities held in this account
transactionForm.accruedInterestHelp: Interest paid out with the redemption. It is recorded as interest income and arrives with the proceeds in a single cash entry — do not add a separate transaction for it.
transactionForm.statusLockedToParent: This transaction is part of a split. Change the split transaction's status instead, so both sides change together.
transactionForm.noSplitRatioWarning: No split ratio is set on this transaction. Enter the ratio as it was announced before saving — Monize won't assume one for you.
transactionForm.splitRatioHelp: Enter the ratio as it was announced. For a 2-for-1 split use 2 new and 1 old; for a 1-for-2 reverse split use 1 new and 2 old. Effective ratio:
transactionForm.newPriceAfterSplit: New Price per Share After Split (optional)
transactionForm.holdingPreviewCostBasisNote: Total cost basis is preserved across the split.
transactionForm.noSharesOnDate: No shares of this security were held in this account on {date}; the split will be recorded but won't change holdings until shares are added on or before that date.
transactionForm.transferCostNote: The cost per share is what the shares cost in the source account on the transfer date. It is worked out when you save and carried to the destination, so your gain and profit reports stay correct. This moves shares only; no cash changes hands.
transactionForm.returnOfCapitalNote: A return of capital is not income. It pays back part of what the shares cost, so it lowers the cost basis of your holding by this amount. Anything beyond the remaining cost basis is reported as a realized capital gain.
transactionForm.conversionHelp: Adjust the rate or the converted total to match the amount actually posted to your cash account.
transactionForm.submitCreateDescription: Save it and close this window.
transactionForm.submitCreateAndNewDescription: Save it and start another, keeping the account and date.
transactionForm.toastSameAccount: Source and destination accounts must be different
transactionForm.toastQuantityRequired: Quantity must be greater than zero
transactionForm.toastSplitRatioRequired: Split ratio must be greater than zero
transactionForm.toastPairedLegError: Could not load the paired transfer leg; reopen and try again
transactionForm.exchangeRateUnresolved: No {from} to {to} rate is available. Enter one, or the converted total, before saving.
transactionForm.toastExchangeRateRequired: Enter an exchange rate before saving a cross-currency trade.
